applications.description: Run the AdaptixCore company and supervise the platform from one place.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/founder-command -> adaptix-founder + core, billing, calendar, investor, nemsis; ModuleSwitcher 'Founder' bucket (20 rows, all founderOnly) — those rows are internal workspaces here

applications.description: Cross-domain operational oversight: live calls, units, hospitals and revenue signals on one board.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; src/lib/api/missionControl.ts reads /api/v1/cad/units, /api/v1/cad/incidents, /api/v1/hospital/hospitals, /api/v1/billing/cortex/insights, /api/v1/billing/revenue/command, /api/v1/air/adsb/bbox — an aggregation surface that owns no domain records, so it declares `aggregates` instead of a primary service. Offered when the tenant holds ANY aggregated product. Deliberately has no workspaces: it is one board (app/workspace/mission-control/page.tsx is the only page), not a family of surfaces.

applications.description: Receive work, assign units and follow every response through to close.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/cad -> adaptix-cad; module_registry cad

applications.description: What the crew works from in the unit: status, assignment, navigation, paging and messages.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/mdt -> adaptix-cad, /api/v1/crewlink -> adaptix-cad + adaptix-crew, /api/v1/crew -> adaptix-crew, /api/v1/field -> adaptix-field. The umbrella shell route is the MDT surface until a dedicated field shell exists; CrewLink and Crew are workspaces with their own module gates, so consolidation widens no entitlement.

applications.description: Schedule and run interfacility and non-emergency transports end to end.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/transportlink/page.tsx is the navigated root on main; routes registry PUBLIC product entry); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/transport AND /api/v1/transportlink -> adaptix-transport (module_registry records adaptix-transportlink for the module; the gateway is the routing truth and is what is recorded here). The external requester/status portal stays a separate audience surface.

applications.description: Air-medical missions from request through flight following and post-flight.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/air AND /api/v1/air-pilot -> adaptix-air. Adaptix-Air-Service-Pilot has no gateway audience of its own, so the pilot surface is a workspace of this application, never a second app.

applications.description: Destination capacity, diversion, bed reservations, transfers and patient handoff.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (layout gates module 'hospital'); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/hospital -> adaptix-hospital, /api/v1/facilities -> adaptix-facilities. Facility-Registry-Service owns facility data; this is the human workspace. Hospital staff authenticate through their own portal session, not the agency JWT.

applications.description: Document, validate, sign and submit the patient care record.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/epcr -> adaptix-epcr; module_registry epcr

applications.description: Mobile integrated healthcare: enrolled people, programs, visits, escalations and follow-up.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (layout gates module 'mih_community_paramedicine'; _components read /api/v1/mih/escalations, /thresholds, /utilization via useModuleData — real data binding, no placeholders); gateway mih_route.py -> adaptix-mih; production GET /api/v1/mih/healthz 200 on 2026-09-17. Runtime operator journey not yet proven by this registry — status reflects route, gate and live backend, not Tier-5 evidence.

applications.description: Chart review, peer review, medical-director oversight and quality-improvement trends.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/quality reads /api/v1/quality x17 and /api/v1/epcr x12; routes registry gates /quality on the epcr entitlement — there is no 'quality' module id); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/quality AND /api/v1/qa -> adaptix-epcr. Adaptix-QA-Service (adaptix-qa) consumes finalized-chart events; it is not the surface's routed backend.

applications.description: Critical care transport operations. Backend contracts exist; no operator surface is offered yet.
applications.source: No app/ route on Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py routes no /api/v1/cct prefix (adaptix-cct is a declared audience only); production GET /api/v1/cct/healthz -> 401 at the gateway edge. module_registry cct_transport_ops is a Stripe bundle marker, not an application entitlement. Activation requires route, gateway route, server authorization, deployment and runtime proof.

applications.description: A separate patient- and community-facing application. Not built or deployed.
applications.source: Adaptix-Citizen-App exists in the fleet inventory; no web route, no gateway route, no audience. Patient-Identity-Service is NOT this application. The patient billing portal is Billing's portal, not this.

applications.description: Fire incidents, apparatus, stations, hydrants, preplans, inspections and NERIS reporting.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/fire -> adaptix-fire, /api/v1/neris -> adaptix-neris. Preplan, Hydrant and Wildland services are NOT gateway-routed (no /api/v1/preplan|hydrant|wildland RouteEntry; Preplan-Service has no ECS footprint per PREPLAN-SERVICE-NOT-DEPLOYED), so their surfaces here are served by Fire-Service and they are not listed as supporting services until they are routed.

applications.description: Risk assessments, households, campaigns, interventions and outcomes for community risk reduction.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/fire/crr is the only CRR surface); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/crr -> adaptix-fire; module_registry crr (audience adaptix-fire, implies fire). Adaptix-CRR-Service has no gateway audience yet. CRR is a distinct job with its own purchasable module, so it is a separate application whose root currently lives under the Fire route tree; route ownership resolves by longest prefix.

applications.description: EMS revenue cycle: eligibility, coding, claims, clearinghouse, remittance, denials, appeals and patient balances.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/billing -> adaptix-billing (+ core), /api/v1/payments -> adaptix-payments, /api/v1/trustsign -> adaptix-trustsign. Patient/claim receivables live HERE, never in Finance. Office Ally is a migration-only adapter and belongs to Administration imports, not to Billing's live path (Stedi is the only live clearinghouse).

applications.description: Company financial management: ledger, P&L, budgets, expenses and corporate receivables.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree; Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/finance -> adaptix-finance. Company/accounting A/R only — patient/claim A/R is Billing's.

applications.description: Staff the organization: scheduling, people, labor, HR, training, credentials and availability.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/workforce/layout.tsx gates ANY-OF workforce/scheduling/labor; /workspace/training gates 'training'); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/workforce -> adaptix-workforce + adaptix-labor, /api/v1/scheduling AND /api/v1/labor -> adaptix-labor, /api/v1/hr -> adaptix-hr, /api/v1/training -> adaptix-training. The application is offered when ANY of its products is held (an HR-only tenant has /workspace/hr today and must still find it); entitlements stay separate per workspace: a scheduling-only tenant sees the Schedule workspaces, never Labor, HR or Training (module_registry: scheduling implies none of them).

applications.description: Physical operational assets: fleet, inventory, medications, narcotics, work orders, purchasing and audits.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/operations/page.tsx: 'AdaptixCore-AssetOps hub', reads /api/v1/assetops x37); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/assetops -> adaptix-assetops, /api/v1/fleet -> adaptix-fleet, /api/v1/inventory -> adaptix-inventory, /api/v1/medications -> adaptix-medications, /api/v1/narcotics -> adaptix-narcotics. AssetOps orchestrates; each domain service keeps its own truth (no second inventory, narcotics log or vehicle registry). Device management is Administration's, referenced here.

applications.description: Internal commercial work: CRM, customer success, partners, marketing, support and office operations.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/crm reads /api/v1/crm x124 + /api/v1/marketing x9; app/workspace/support); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/crm -> adaptix-crm, customer-success, partner, marketing, office each -> their own audience. Customer Success, Partner, Marketing and Office have no web surface of their own on main; they are services this application will host as workspaces. Visibility stays ADMIN because both rows were admin-only before.

applications.description: Reports, analytics and the governed natural-language console (Ask AdaptixCore).
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (reports reads /api/v1/reports + cross-module report prefixes; analytics reads /api/v1/analytics x64 + graph; ask carries its own ModuleGate 'intelligence'); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/reports AND /api/v1/intelligence -> adaptix-core, /api/v1/analytics -> adaptix-analytics, /api/v1/graph -> adaptix-graph. The root is Reports because it is served by Core and reachable by every tenant; Analytics is a workspace behind the sold 'analytics' module (its backend mints no audience without it, so an ungated entry would be a control that can only fail).

applications.description: Compliance, documents, policies, legal and audit evidence.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (compliance reads /api/v1/compliance x205; documents reads /api/v1/forms x68 + /api/v1/documents x36; audit-logs reads /api/v1/admin); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/compliance -> adaptix-compliance (+ core), /api/v1/documents -> adaptix-documents, /api/v1/policy, /api/v1/legal, /api/v1/audit, /api/v1/forms -> their own audiences. Audit-Service is a capability this application reads; it is not the application.

applications.description: Organization, users, roles, applications and entitlements, devices, integrations, imports/exports, onboarding and platform configuration.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (admin reads /api/v1/users, core, organization, agency; api-keys, hl7, integrations, device x51, onboarding x46; /workspace/ai surfaces founder-command AI telemetry with no gate of its own, so it stays ADMIN); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/admin, agency, users, api-keys, onboarding -> adaptix-core; /api/v1/app-management, device, integrations, hl7, imports, exports, officeally -> their own audiences. /workspace/interop and /workspace/interoperability are both real pages today; consolidating them is Web-App work, not a registry decision. Office Ally lives here as a historical import adapter, never as a billing path.

applications.description: Founder / development demo launcher. Not a production application.
applications.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/demos/page.tsx links founder-command demo surfaces; no backend calls). Listed so status enforcement has a real EXPERIMENTAL entry to exclude from customer navigation.

shared_capabilities.source: Web-App main 35b4a12e app/ route tree (app/workspace/cortex-ai reads /api/v1/ai x38); Gateway main 5658fb1c routes.py /api/v1/ai -> adaptix-ai, /api/v1/cortex -> adaptix-cortex + core; the pricing catalog sells Cortex as module 'cortex' and the runtime grant is 'ai', so either opens the surface.
